facts.fact: 全章第一句：他们不再孤独
Clay 过海峡去找男孩，腰间藏着手枪
facts.anchor: a handgun hidden at his waist

facts.fact: 他不向男孩挥手，是怕重演上一个女人上岛之后的事
facts.anchor: He remembers what happened last time.
There’s people, Ellie. A community, up in the trees.

facts.fact: 地方叫 St. Helena Harbor，从前是美国南海岸的一部分
facts.anchor: they call it St. Helena Harbor.

facts.fact: 社群共七十三人，住在废弃的高尔夫球场
facts.anchor: There are seventy-three members of their community

facts.fact: 他们的语言省掉客套，每个词都得挣自己的位置
facts.anchor: Every word must earn its place.

facts.fact: 有位妇女抱着一本《秘密花园》，后来管它叫"绿色的书"
facts.anchor: One woman clutches a copy of The Secret Garden

facts.fact: 她把 Clay 的手按在肚子上，承认自己可能怀了孩子
facts.anchor: I don’t know for sure, not yet, but I think so.

facts.fact: 她保证 Alice 那次的事不会发生在自己身上
facts.anchor: What happened to Alice won’t happen to me.

facts.fact: 他们用石头和一条废弃锚链把岛拴上岸
facts.anchor: Mooring ourselves here so we won’t be pulled out to sea.

facts.fact: 日落时海平线上出现传说中的那道绿闪
全书最后一句：Clay 对她说，你就是我的祖国
